component.name: Argus
component.summary: Modern, fluid video player, music player & streaming companion

description.p: Argus is an ultra-responsive, privacy-centric media player and streaming hub featuring mpv-accelerated video and music playback, Apple Music-style radio and audio streams, smart subtitle auto-synchronization, and multi-profile tracking.

ul.li: Upgraded Web movie playback with CORS & HLS stream relay, companion transcode support, and browser-reliability stream ranking
Added Windows ARM64 sidecar support, PiP geometry persistence, async SVP IPC, and Web relay settings
Updated npm and Cargo dependencies and synchronized Flatpak offline sources
Fixed Tokio reactor NativePanic on app exit across thumbs, stream proxy, multiview, DVR, and torrent engine shutdown hooks
Eliminated 12.7s macOS main-thread freeze when opening the Music view by offloading SQLite IPC commands and indexing album/artist library queries (migration 9)
Offloaded remaining synchronous disk-I/O IPC commands (downloads, subtitle fonts, ASR models, log exports, shaders, diagnostics) off the main thread
Made the Picture-in-Picture window draggable and preserved its last position
Bounded shutdown timeouts across torrent, proxy, thumbs, multiview, and DVR services to eliminate macOS quit hangs
Async IPC offloading for disk and temp-directory commands
Eliminated 18s macOS AppKit main-thread hang by offloading synchronous disk and temp-directory IPC commands to Tokio blocking workers
Windows x64 & ARM64, Android, and iOS build fixes
Windows x64 & ARM64 build fixes for sysinfo 0.40 and libmpv staging
Android native torrent bridge compatibility with jni 0.21
Native iOS/iPadOS archive pipeline via tauri ios build
Zero-vulnerability security hardening and Liquid Glass UI parity
Zero-vulnerability security hardening with CodeQL static analysis automation
Apple Liquid Glass harmonized UI design across player overlays and menus
AZSO fast-start streaming engine upgrades (stages 1-5) for low-latency playback
Multi-platform release automation for macOS, Windows x64/ARM64, Linux Flatpak/deb/rpm, iOS, Android, and Smart TVs
Apple Music-grade Radio view with live streams and custom audio stream tuner
Resilient SQLite catalog caching and instant offline playback recovery
Apple Music multi-hue gradient meshes for artist and album artwork
Windows ARM64 native target support and Flatpak bundle pipeline
